title: OceanEmbed
subtitle: 3D Subsurface Ocean Temperature Reconstruction via Satellite AI
description: A deep-learning framework that reconstructs daily 3D ocean temperature fields across 15 depths (0–1,000 m) in the North Indian Ocean from satellite surface observations, using a hybrid CNN–Vision Transformer. Validated on two unseen years and 5,512 in-situ Argo float profiles.
features: Hybrid CNN + Vision Transformer encoder-decoder reconstructing 15 subsurface depth levels at 0.25° resolution
0.98°C thermocline RMSE across two unseen test years (33% lower error than seasonal climatology baselines)
Rigorously validated against 5,512 independent in-situ Argo profiling floats (77,388 physical matchups)
Harmonized 14-year multi-satellite dataset (Copernicus OSTIA, DUACS, NASA PO.DAAC) spanning 5,098 days
Rolling 60-day automated live nowcasting engine updating daily from near-real-time satellite feeds
Interactive React 19 oceanographic explorer with linked horizontal maps, vertical cross-sections, and NetCDF exports
metric: Within about 1 °C of real ocean measurements
summary: Reconstructs daily 3D ocean temperature (15 depths, down to 1,000 m) from satellite surface data with a hybrid CNN–Vision Transformer.
role: Built end to end: satellite data pipeline, deep-learning model, API and explorer interface.

results.label: Average error
results.note: 0.98 °C RMSE at the thermocline on two years the model never saw, 33% lower than the seasonal-average baseline.

results.label: Real ocean profiles
results.note: Checked against independent Argo float measurements (77,388 matchups).

results.label: Depth levels
results.note: Surface down to 1,000 m, rebuilt daily at 0.25° resolution.

title: UrbanTrace
subtitle: Multi-Camera ANPR Tracking & Traffic Intelligence
description: An edge AI engine developed for high-assurance vehicle tracking under noisy sensor reads. Instead of brittle exact string matching, UrbanTrace fuses character-level OCR probability matrices, vehicle appearance embeddings, and congestion-aware travel times using a global min-cost flow solver.
features: Global Min-Cost Flow tracking engine achieving 0.972 IDF1 and 9x fewer identity errors on 100K+ reads
Probabilistic 3-evidence fusion combining character OCR matrices, visual appearance, and road travel time
Consensus plate repair boosting degraded multi-camera plate accuracy from 87.8% to 99.95%
Real-time WebSocket alerts for cloned plates (0.998 AUC), impossible speeds, and probabilistic watchlists
Full-featured React 19 operator console with MapLibre GL heatmaps, corridor analytics, and journey explainability
Self-contained, zero-cloud edge deployment packaged in a 329 MB multi-stage Docker container
summary: Tracks vehicles across city cameras by fusing noisy plate reads, appearance and travel time, and flags cloned plates in real time.
role: Built end to end: tracking engine, plate-repair logic, real-time alerts and operator console.

results.label: Identity accuracy
results.note: IDF1 0.972: how reliably each vehicle keeps the same identity across cameras, with 9× fewer identity errors than exact plate matching.

results.label: Plate accuracy
results.note: Badly read plates repaired by combining reads from several cameras.

results.label: Cloned-plate detection
results.note: AUC 0.998 (1.0 is perfect): spots the same plate appearing in two places at once.

title: TrueCite
subtitle: Citation-Verified Legal RAG for Ayurveda IP & Regulatory Compliance
description: A high-assurance, citation-verified legal retrieval-augmented generation engine. Rather than allowing probabilistic LLM hallucinations, TrueCite enforces a 3-layer deterministic defense ensuring every legal claim strictly entails its statutory passage, declining ungrounded queries with calibrated confidence.
features: 3-layer deterministic defense against legal hallucinations with 0 false answers on benchmarks
Bilingual hybrid retrieval fusing BAAI/bge-m3 dense embeddings and BM25Okapi via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
2-of-3 statutory entailment consensus checking before any claim is presented to the user
Statutory knowledge graph connecting 20 legal instruments (Patents, Biodiversity, FSSAI, WIPO) and 509 cross-references
Multi-provider LLM backend supporting local Ollama (Qwen 2.5), Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude
Zero-dependency vanilla web interface streaming live verification stages via Server-Sent Events (SSE)
summary: Legal Q&A assistant that cites its sources and checks every claim against the statute before answering.
role: Built end to end: retrieval pipeline, verification layers, knowledge graph and streaming interface.

results.label: False answers
results.note: On the benchmark questions, a claim that fails verification is refused instead of shown.

results.label: Consensus check
results.note: A claim must pass two of three entailment checks against the statute text.

results.label: Laws · cross-references
results.note: Legal instruments and the links between them in the knowledge graph.

title: FieldCast
subtitle: Hyperlocal Agro-Weather Downscaling with Calibrated Confidence
description: An agro-meteorological downscaling engine that downscales official block forecasts to 9,802 gram panchayats across the Western Ghats. Incorporates 245° orographic rain-shadow modeling and Mahalanobis epistemic support to provide farmers with honest prediction intervals and asymmetric risk-aware advisories.
features: Downscales block weather forecasts to 9,802 gram panchayats across 134 Western Ghats blocks
Two-stage LightGBM quantile regression architecture modeling rain occurrence and conditional precipitation
Hyperlocal 245° monsoon orographic terrain modeling capturing windward slopes and leeward rain shadows
Calibrated 80% prediction intervals verified against historical NOAA GHCN-D rain gauge networks
Zero-dependency NumPy-only inference engine executing 257-panchayat block predictions in ~100 ms
Interactive MapLibre GL dashboard delivering plain-language agricultural spray, irrigation, and harvest advisories
summary: Turns block-level weather forecasts into forecasts for 9,802 gram panchayats, with calibrated confidence ranges.
role: Built end to end: terrain features, two-stage model, calibration and the map dashboard.

results.label: Villages covered
results.note: Gram panchayats across 134 Western Ghats blocks, from block-level forecasts.

results.label: Calibrated range
results.note: Prediction intervals checked against NOAA rain-gauge records.

results.label: Per block
results.note: 257 village forecasts per block from a NumPy-only inference engine.

Farmer portal: inventory management, order fulfilment, and earnings

title: CampusFlow
subtitle: College LMS and Online Examination Platform
description: A role-based college management, learning, and online examination platform for administrators, lecturers, and students: departments, sections, coursework, assignments, grading, and results. Secure online exams, a live invigilator view, and sandboxed coding assessments are under active development.
features: Role-based access control for administrators, lecturers, and students
Departments, sections, coursework, assignments, grading, and results
Modular-monolith backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, PostgreSQL, Redis
Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4
In progress: browser-based exam monitoring, live invigilator dashboard, sandboxed code execution (C, C++, Java, Python, SQL)
summary: College LMS and online examination platform with role-based access for admins, lecturers and students.
role: Designing and building the platform: role-based access, coursework and the exam module.

title: OMNIFIX
subtitle: Autonomous Multi-Agent Security Repair
description: A coordinated team of AI agents that detects vulnerabilities in Python code, writes exploits to prove impact, applies patches, and validates fixes — all in a closed-loop autonomous workflow with zero human intervention.
features: Security Auditor: Static analysis mapped to CWE vulnerability standards
Exploit Generator: Creates proof-of-concept exploits for real-world impact demonstration
Patch Architect: Generates secure, regression-free code patches
Patch Validator: Bandit static analysis ensures fix validity
Closed-loop execution: Repeats until code passes all security checks
summary: Multi-agent system that finds, exploits, patches and re-validates Python security vulnerabilities in a closed loop.

title: EmailEnv
subtitle: AI Email Agent Simulation & Training Platform
description: A Streamlit-based interactive platform simulating how AI agents read, classify, and act on email streams — modeling sequential decision-making, rewards, and a hybrid fallback architecture for high-confidence processing.
features: Interactive Training Mode with Starter, Medium, and Advanced difficulty levels
Step-by-step email processing with live status updates and reward scoring
Hybrid AI System: Gemini API with instantaneous local fallback agent
Premium dark-theme UI built natively in Streamlit for optimal observability
summary: Interactive simulator and benchmark for AI agents that read, classify and act on email streams.

title: AirForge
subtitle: Gesture-Controlled Creative Workspace
description: A webcam-based gesture-controlled workspace where hand tracking maps complex gestures to 2D brush strokes and 3D voxel model construction — no plugins, no stylus, just your hands.
features: Ink Space: Neon glow drawing, freehand shapes, and gesture-based select/move
Build Space: Orbit controls, grid overlays, and 3D voxel placement
Computer Vision Hand Tracking: Pinch to draw, open palm to place or orbit camera
Canvas Export: High-resolution PNG outputs from both 2D and 3D scenes
summary: Browser workspace where webcam hand tracking draws in 2D and builds in 3D, no stylus or plugins.

title: QubitScope
subtitle: Interactive Quantum Bloch Sphere Simulator
description: An interactive quantum simulation tool that visualizes the real-time evolution of a single qubit on a 3D Bloch sphere — enabling users to apply quantum gates and inspect superposition and phase shifts directly in the browser.
features: Interactive 3D Bloch Sphere with real-time qubit state visualization
Live quantum gate transformations: X, Z, and Hadamard gates
Real-time measurement probability calculations
State representation in Dirac notation with complete gate history tracking
summary: Interactive 3D Bloch-sphere simulator for single-qubit states, gates and measurement.
